_note: Resource relationship map rendered at #/map by assets/js/explore.js. A conceptual teaching model: each resource answers the ten questions every lesson answers. Facts come from the Academy lessons and Microsoft Learn (retrieved 2026-10-06).

resources.name: Microsoft Entra tenant
resources.plain: Your organization's identity directory: where every user, group and app identity lives, and the sign-in service subscriptions trust.

q.contains: Nothing: it is the top of the identity side.
q.dependsOn: A domain name (at least <name>.onmicrosoft.com).
q.dependents: Subscriptions trust it to authenticate; users, groups and managed identities live in it.
q.manage: Microsoft Entra roles, such as Global Administrator and User Administrator.
q.network: Not applicable: sign-in happens against Microsoft Entra ID.
q.monitor: Microsoft Entra sign-in and audit logs.
q.protect: Least-privilege Entra roles, MFA, Conditional Access, two emergency access accounts.
q.recover: Deleted users and Microsoft 365 groups can be restored for 30 days.
q.cost: Microsoft Entra ID Free is included; P1 and P2 are per-user licences.
q.remove: Outside AZ-104. Every subscription that trusts it must be moved or canceled first.

resources.name: Management group
resources.plain: A folder for subscriptions, so policy and access can be assigned once for many of them.

q.contains: The tenant root management group or a parent management group, up to six levels deep (not counting root and subscriptions).
q.dependsOn: The tenant.
q.dependents: Child management groups and subscriptions inherit its policy and role assignments.
q.manage: Management Group Contributor, or Owner on the management group.
q.network: Not networked.
q.monitor: Policy compliance across everything under it.
q.protect: Policy and role assignments made here apply below. Locks can't be applied to a management group.
q.recover: Re-create it and move subscriptions back; assignments made on it must be re-created.
q.cost: Free.
q.remove: Move its subscriptions and child groups out first: it must be empty to delete.

resources.name: Subscription
resources.plain: The billing and management container that resource groups live in. It trusts exactly one Microsoft Entra tenant; a tenant can have many subscriptions.

q.contains: A management group (the root one by default).
q.dependsOn: A billing account or offer, and the one tenant it trusts.
q.dependents: Resource groups, every resource in them, budgets, resource provider registrations.
q.manage: Owner or Contributor at subscription scope; billing roles for billing.
q.network: Each virtual network belongs to one subscription; peering can connect subscriptions.
q.monitor: The activity log (keep it longer with a subscription diagnostic setting) and Cost Management.
q.protect: Policy and RBAC at this scope, budgets, locks.
q.recover: Changing its directory permanently deletes its Azure role assignments: plan before moving it.
q.cost: The billing boundary: all its resources' charges roll up here.
q.remove: Delete or move its resources, then cancel it in Cost Management + Billing.

resources.name: Resource group
resources.plain: A container for resources that share a lifecycle: deployed, managed and deleted together.

q.contains: A subscription.
q.dependsOn: The subscription, and a location where Azure stores the group's metadata.
q.dependents: Every resource in it. Each resource belongs to exactly one resource group, and can sit in a different region from it.
q.manage: Roles at resource group scope inherit to everything in it.
q.network: None itself. Its resources can connect to resources in other groups.
q.monitor: Activity log filtered to the group; cost by resource group.
q.protect: Locks, Policy and RBAC at resource group scope.
q.recover: There's no undo for the group; only resources with their own soft delete can come back.
q.cost: Free; shows the total of its resources.
q.remove: Check for locks, then delete it: every resource in it is deleted too.

resources.name: Users and groups
resources.type: Microsoft Entra directory objects (not Azure resources)
resources.plain: The people and groups that sign in and receive access, licences and roles.

q.contains: The tenant, not a subscription or resource group.
q.dependsOn: The tenant. A licence needs the user's usage location; dynamic groups need Entra ID P1.
q.dependents: Role assignments, licences and app access target them.
q.manage: User Administrator, Groups Administrator, Guest Inviter.
q.network: Not networked.
q.monitor: Sign-in and audit logs.
q.protect: MFA, Conditional Access, self-service password reset.
q.recover: Deleted users and Microsoft 365 groups: restorable for 30 days.
q.cost: Free objects; licences are per user.
q.remove: Check what the group grants (roles, licences, apps) before deleting it.

resources.name: Role assignment
resources.plain: The link between who (a principal), what (a role) and where (a scope).

q.contains: Attached to a scope: management group, subscription, resource group or resource.
q.dependsOn: A principal and a role definition.
q.dependents: Every request that principal makes at that scope and below.
q.manage: Owner, User Access Administrator, Role Based Access Control Administrator.
q.network: Not networked.
q.monitor: Activity log entries for role assignment writes and deletes.
q.protect: Narrowest scope, assign to groups, review regularly.
q.recover: Re-create it. Deleting a principal leaves an "Identity not found" assignment to clean up.
q.cost: Free.
q.remove: Remove it at the scope where it was made; an inherited assignment can't be removed lower down.

resources.name: Policy assignment
resources.plain: A rule (or set of rules) applied to a scope, evaluated whenever resources are created or updated.

q.contains: A scope such as a management group, subscription or resource group.
q.dependsOn: A policy definition or initiative; a managed identity for modify and deployIfNotExists.
q.dependents: Every create and update request in scope is evaluated against it.
q.manage: Resource Policy Contributor or Owner.
q.network: Not networked.
q.monitor: Policy compliance; activity log.
q.protect: Exemptions are explicit, time-bound and auditable.
q.recover: Re-assign it; remediation tasks fix existing resources.
q.cost: Free for Azure resources.
q.remove: Delete it where it was assigned: deleting a resource group doesn't remove subscription-scope assignments.

resources.name: Virtual network
resources.plain: Your private network in one region and one subscription.

q.contains: A resource group; one region and one subscription.
q.dependsOn: A non-overlapping private address space.
q.dependents: Subnets, and through them NICs, private endpoints, Bastion and load balancer backends. Anything connected must be in the same region and subscription.
q.manage: Network Contributor.
q.network: Private addresses; connects to other virtual networks by peering (not transitive).
q.monitor: Network insights, Network Watcher, virtual network flow logs.
q.protect: NSGs on subnets, no public IPs by default, locks.
q.recover: Redeploy from a template: keep the design as code.
q.cost: No charge for the network itself; peering traffic is charged per GB.
q.remove: Delete what is connected to its subnets first (or the resource group), and remove peerings on both sides.

resources.name: Subnet
resources.plain: A slice of a virtual network's address space where resources are placed.

q.contains: A virtual network.
q.dependsOn: A range inside the network's address space. Azure reserves five addresses in every subnet.
q.dependents: NICs, private endpoints, NSG and route table associations, service endpoints.
q.manage: Network Contributor.
q.network: Its route table decides next hops; its NSG filters traffic.
q.monitor: Effective routes and effective security rules of the NICs in it.
q.protect: An NSG association; private subnets with no default outbound access.
q.recover: Redeploy from a template.
q.cost: Free.
q.remove: Azure won't delete a subnet that still has resources in it.

resources.name: Network security group
resources.plain: An ordered list of allow and deny rules for traffic to and from subnets or network interfaces.

q.contains: A resource group, in the same region as what it is associated with.
q.dependsOn: Nothing to exist; an association with a subnet or NIC to act.
q.dependents: Every flow to and from the subnets and NICs it is associated with.
q.manage: Network Contributor.
q.network: Rules by priority (100-4096), first match wins; default rules at 65000 and above.
q.monitor: Effective security rules, IP flow verify, virtual network flow logs.
q.protect: It is the protection: inbound from the internet is denied by default.
q.recover: Redeploy the rules from a template.
q.cost: Free.
q.remove: Dissociate it from subnets and NICs, then delete it.

resources.name: Public IP address
resources.plain: An internet-reachable address you attach to a NIC, load balancer, Bastion or gateway.

q.contains: A resource group, in one region.
q.dependsOn: Nothing to exist. Standard public IPs are static, and zone-redundant by default in regions with zones.
q.dependents: NIC IP configurations, load balancer frontends, Bastion.
q.manage: Network Contributor.
q.network: Internet-facing. A Standard IP is closed to inbound traffic until an NSG allows it.
q.monitor: Network Watcher connectivity tools; the IP's metrics.
q.protect: NSGs on the NIC or subnet; prefer Bastion to public IPs on VMs.
q.recover: Re-create it; a new IP usually means updating DNS.
q.cost: Standard public IPs bill hourly whether or not they are attached.
q.remove: Dissociate it and update DNS records that point at it. Alias records empty themselves.

resources.name: Network interface
resources.plain: The VM's network adapter: it takes a private IP from a subnet and can carry a public IP.

q.contains: A resource group, in the same region and subscription as its VM and virtual network.
q.dependsOn: A subnet; optionally a public IP and an NSG.
q.dependents: The VM it is attached to; load balancer backend pools reference it.
q.manage: Network Contributor.
q.network: Private IP from its subnet. You can change its subnet, not its virtual network.
q.monitor: Effective routes and effective security rules (the VM must be running).
q.protect: An NSG on the NIC as well as on the subnet.
q.recover: Re-create it; the virtual network can't change on an existing NIC.
q.cost: No separate charge.
q.remove: A VM must keep at least one NIC. After deleting a VM, check whether its NIC was deleted with it.

resources.name: Virtual machine
resources.plain: A server you rent: you choose size, image, disks and network, and you manage the operating system.

q.contains: A resource group. Zone or availability set is chosen at creation.
q.dependsOn: A NIC, a managed OS disk, an image, and vCPU quota in the region.
q.dependents: Load balancer backends (through its NIC), backup items, Site Recovery replicas, alert rules.
q.manage: Virtual Machine Contributor manages the VM; signing in to the OS is a separate permission.
q.network: Through its NICs. Reach it with Bastion rather than an open RDP or SSH port.
q.monitor: Host metrics automatically; guest metrics and logs with the Azure Monitor Agent; VM insights.
q.protect: Encryption at host, NSGs, no public management ports, locks.
q.recover: Azure Backup restores; Site Recovery fails over to another region.
q.cost: Compute while allocated (shut down from inside the OS still bills); disks and Standard public IPs bill even when deallocated.
q.remove: Deleting the VM doesn't always delete its disks, NIC and public IP: each has a delete option. Check for leftovers, or delete the resource group.

resources.name: Managed disk
resources.plain: Persistent block storage for a VM. Azure manages the storage behind it; you choose type and size.

q.contains: A resource group, in the VM's region (and zone).
q.dependsOn: Nothing to exist; a VM to be used.
q.dependents: The VM it is attached to; snapshots and backups.
q.manage: Virtual Machine Contributor or Contributor.
q.network: Not networked: attached through the VM's host.
q.monitor: Disk metrics (IOPS, throughput) on the VM and the disk.
q.protect: Encrypted at rest by default; encryption at host; snapshots.
q.recover: Snapshots and Azure Backup.
q.cost: Billed by provisioned size and type, attached or not.
q.remove: Unattached disks keep billing: list disks with diskState Unattached and delete what you don't need.

resources.name: Storage account
resources.plain: A named, regional container for blobs, file shares, queues and tables, with its own endpoints, firewall and redundancy.

q.contains: A resource group, in one region. The name is globally unique.
q.dependsOn: A unique name; a service endpoint for virtual network rules; a private endpoint for private access.
q.dependents: Containers, shares, apps, and logs or backups written to it.
q.manage: Storage Account Contributor for configuration; data roles such as Storage Blob Data Contributor for the data.
q.network: Public endpoints restricted by its firewall; private endpoints.
q.monitor: Capacity and transaction metrics; resource logs through diagnostic settings; Storage insights.
q.protect: Firewall, Shared Key disabled, encryption, soft delete, versioning, a delete lock.
q.recover: Soft delete, versioning and snapshots for data; geo-redundancy for regional outages.
q.cost: Capacity by tier and redundancy, plus operations and data transfer.
q.remove: Deleting the account deletes all its data: check locks, replication policies and anything writing to it.

resources.name: Load balancer
resources.plain: One frontend address that spreads TCP and UDP flows across healthy backend VMs.

q.contains: A resource group.
q.dependsOn: A Standard public IP (public) or a subnet (internal); a health probe; NSGs allowing clients and probes.
q.dependents: Clients use its frontend; DNS records may point at its public IP.
q.manage: Network Contributor.
q.network: Frontend IP, backend pool in one VNet, probes from 168.63.129.16, rules.
q.monitor: Data Path Availability and Health Probe Status in Insights.
q.protect: Standard is secure by default: an NSG must allow client traffic.
q.recover: Redeploy from a template.
q.cost: Standard load balancers bill while they exist.
q.remove: Delete it before its public IP, and remove DNS records that point at that IP.

resources.name: Private endpoint
resources.plain: A private IP in your subnet for one specific PaaS resource, such as a storage account's blob service.

q.contains: A resource group; its network interface sits in a subnet.
q.dependsOn: A subnet, the target resource, and a private DNS zone (privatelink) linked to the VNets that use it.
q.dependents: Clients that resolve the resource's name to the private IP: the VNet, peered VNets, on-premises.
q.manage: Network Contributor, plus approval on the target resource.
q.network: A private IP for one resource.
q.monitor: Its traffic metrics; nslookup from inside to prove DNS returns the private IP.
q.protect: Lets you disable the resource's public network access.
q.recover: Redeploy it and its DNS zone group.
q.cost: Hourly, plus data processed.
q.remove: Delete the endpoint, then its DNS records or zone links; re-check the resource's public access setting.

resources.name: App Service plan and web app
resources.plain: A plan is the compute you pay for; web apps and their slots run on it.

q.contains: A resource group. An app runs on a plan in the same region.
q.dependsOn: The plan's tier for features; DNS records at your DNS host for custom domains; a storage account for custom backups.
q.dependents: Users and clients; deployment slots; certificates bound to the app.
q.manage: Contributor or Website Contributor on the app.
q.network: Public <app>.azurewebsites.net endpoint with access restrictions; private endpoint inbound; VNet integration outbound.
q.monitor: App Service metrics, logs and diagnostics.
q.protect: HTTPS Only, minimum TLS version, access restrictions, managed identity.
q.recover: Backups and restore (custom domains and TLS bindings aren't restored); swap a slot back.
q.cost: The plan bills per instance by tier whether or not the apps are busy.
q.remove: Delete apps and slots, then the plan (it bills until deleted); remove DNS records pointing at the app.

resources.name: Container registry
resources.plain: Private storage for container images, pulled by Container Instances and Container Apps.

q.contains: A resource group. The registry name is globally unique.
q.dependsOn: A tier: Basic, Standard or Premium.
q.dependents: Container groups and container apps that pull its images.
q.manage: Contributor for the registry; AcrPush and AcrPull for images.
q.network: Public login server <name>.azurecr.io; private endpoints with Premium.
q.monitor: Registry metrics and resource logs.
q.protect: Admin user disabled; Microsoft Entra identities with AcrPull.
q.recover: Re-push or import images; geo-replication with Premium.
q.cost: A daily rate by tier, plus storage.
q.remove: Deleting the registry deletes every image in it: check what still pulls from it.

resources.name: Log Analytics workspace
resources.plain: Where Azure Monitor keeps logs, queried with KQL.

q.contains: A resource group.
q.dependsOn: Data sources: diagnostic settings and agents with data collection rules.
q.dependents: Log alert rules, VM insights, backup reports, KQL queries.
q.manage: Log Analytics Contributor; Log Analytics Reader to query.
q.network: Agents and diagnostic settings send data to it.
q.monitor: Its own usage and ingestion data.
q.protect: Access control per workspace or table; retention settings.
q.recover: Retention and long-term retention per table.
q.cost: Billed by data ingested and retained beyond the included period.
q.remove: Subscription-scope diagnostic settings and data collection rules that point at it aren't removed with a resource group: delete them too.

resources.name: Recovery Services vault
resources.plain: The vault for VM and file share backups and for Site Recovery replication.

q.contains: A resource group.
q.dependsOn: Storage redundancy, chosen before the first item is protected; backup and replication policies.
q.dependents: Protected items (VMs, file shares) and replicated items.
q.manage: Backup Contributor, Backup Operator, Site Recovery Contributor.
q.network: Failover targets a network in the secondary region; optional private endpoints.
q.monitor: Backup jobs, built-in Azure Monitor alerts, backup reports through diagnostic settings.
q.protect: Soft delete (14 days), RBAC, Cross Region Restore with geo-redundant storage.
q.recover: It is the recovery mechanism: restore from recovery points, fail over replicas.
q.cost: Per protected instance plus backup storage; Site Recovery per protected instance plus replica storage.
q.remove: Stop protection and delete backup data (soft-deleted items count), then delete the vault.
